description: Search Cesure's catalog of free pieces by words of a title, a composer or both: a piece is found when each word is in one of them, a short joining word such as 'by' aside; the best matches come first, 20 a call (offset skips that many; when there are more, the answer's more gives the next offset); returns title, artist, licence and link.

offset.description: How many pieces to skip, best matches first (default 0): the answer's more gives the next.

query.description: Words of a title or a composer; empty lists the catalog.

name: search_catalog
title: Search the catalog
